sentences.zh: 你现在对这件事是如何发生的有什么理解？

sentences.en: What's your understanding now of how that happened?
sentences.zh: 这里有几件事在发生。

sentences.en: There are a couple of things going on here.
sentences.zh: 皮特·布蒂吉格在“超级星期二”上注定会惨败，那是在南卡罗来纳州之后仅三天。

sentences.en: Pete Buttigieg was on track to get totally waxed on Super Tuesday, which is just three days after South Carolina.
sentences.zh: 所以他面临的不仅仅是失败，不仅仅是挫折，而是某种

sentences.en: So he is staring at the possibility of not just defeat and not just a setback, but something
sentences.zh: 政治羞辱，从一个月前基本赢得爱荷华州，与伯尼·桑德斯平分秋色，到在“超级星期二”上一无所获。

sentences.en: like political humiliation to go in a month from essentially winning Iowa, basically splitting the win with Bernie Sanders to winning absolutely nothing on Super Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 所以有一种自利的逻辑，那就是，你知道，也许你应该带着赢利在此时离开牌桌。

sentences.en: And so there is a logic of self-interest that says, you know, maybe you should take your winnings and walk away from the table at this point.
sentences.zh: 艾米·克洛布查尔面临的情况有些不同，因为她看起来确实会赢得她的

sentences.en: Amy Klobuchar faces a somewhat different situation because she does look like she will win her
sentences.zh: 家乡明尼苏达州，但她在那个时候已经足够清醒，认识到她在“超级星期二”之后在竞选中确实没有前进的道路。

sentences.en: home state of Minnesota, but she is clear-eyed enough at that point to recognize there's really no path forward for her in the race beyond Super Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 然而，除了自利之外，这两位候选人一直以来都是最直言不讳的，

sentences.en: Beyond the self-interest, though, these are two of the candidates who have been the bluntest
sentences.zh: 他们一直对提名桑德斯的后果表示担忧。

sentences.en: and most pointed all along about their concern for the implications of nominating Sanders.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在谈论提名桑德斯的想法，认为这在政治上是非常、非常冒险的。

sentences.en: They have been talking about the idea of nominating Sanders as deeply, deeply politically risky.
sentences.zh: 有些人可以自己算算账，看到在内华达州和南卡罗来纳州之后，

sentences.en: And there are people who can do the math for themselves and see that after Nevada and South
sentences.zh: 竞选中真正只有两名候选人在全国层面上表现出色，足以支撑到最后。

sentences.en: Carolina, there are really only two candidates in this race who are putting up big numbers on the national level in the way that it would take to go the distance.
sentences.zh: 而在那两位候选人之间，毫无疑问他们更倾向于拜登还是桑德斯。

sentences.en: And between those two candidates, there's no question about whether they're closer to Biden or Sanders.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那么在这一点上，南卡罗来纳州和“超级星期二”之后，拜登是领先者。

sentences.en: Okay, so at this point, post-South Carolina and post-Super Tuesday, Biden is the front winner.
sentences.zh: 但还有大量的初选和代表名额，理论上，桑德斯还有时间卷土重来，对吧？

sentences.en: But there's a ton of primaries and delegates left and still, theoretically, time for a
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: Sanders comeback, right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it turns out to be very much a theoretical exercise, the Sanders comeback.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，桑德斯的东山再起在很大程度上只是一种理论上的推演。

sentences.en: You see, starting right after Super Tuesday, he points the way to the next round of primaries, most importantly, Michigan.
sentences.zh: 你看，从“超级星期二”之后，他就开始为下一轮初选指明方向，其中最重要的是密歇根州。

sentences.en: Well, the joe-mentum continues.
sentences.zh: 嗯，“拜登势头”（Joe-mentum）仍在持续。

sentences.en: Former Vice President Biden sweeping to victory overnight in a pivotal primary conteSt.
sentences.zh: 前副总统拜登昨夜在一场关键的初选中大获全胜。

sentences.en: Sanders ends up totally flopping in Michigan.
sentences.zh: 桑德斯最终在密歇根州彻底惨败。

sentences.en: It's a blowout in the state.
sentences.zh: 他在该州遭遇了滑铁卢。

sentences.en: Biden sweeping every county in Michigan, Missouri, and Mississippi.
sentences.zh: 拜登横扫了密歇根州、密苏里州和密西西比州的每一个县。

sentences.en: He also won Idaho, the wins, giving him a commanding 160-delegate lead over Sanders.
sentences.zh: 他还赢下了爱达荷州，这些胜利使他领先桑德斯160张代表票，占据了绝对优势。

sentences.en: And what happens essentially the night that Biden wins in Michigan and in a number of other
sentences.zh: 而在拜登赢得密歇根州和其他几个重要州的那天晚上，基本上发生了什么呢？

sentences.en: important states is that the campaign is essentially frozen in place by a force that hits the campaign and hits the entire country in a way that nobody could have anticipated.
sentences.zh: 竞选活动被一股力量彻底冻结了，这股力量以一种无人能预料的方式冲击了竞选，也冲击了整个国家。

sentences.en: And of course, that's the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 当然，那就是新冠病毒。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁版？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《时报》一个月，而且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Alex, how exactly does the coronavirus epidemic, eventually becomes a pandemic, how does that hurt Sanders and help Biden?
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯，新冠疫情最终演变成全球大流行，这究竟是如何损害桑德斯并帮助拜登的？

sentences.en: That's not entirely intuitive to me.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说并不完全直观。

sentences.en: Well, what it does is it essentially ends the active portion of the campaign.
sentences.zh: 嗯，它实际上终结了竞选的活跃阶段。

sentences.en: On the night of the March 10th primaries, both of them are supposed to hold election night events where they address a roaring crowd of supporters.
sentences.zh: 在3月10日初选之夜，他们两人本应举行选举之夜活动，向欢呼的支持者发表演讲。

sentences.en: Both of those events get canceled.
sentences.zh: 这两场活动都被取消了。

sentences.en: There have been no campaign rallies since then.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，再也没有举行过竞选集会。

sentences.en: Bernie Sanders cannot hit the road and gather tens of thousands of people in stadiums and deliver a forceful plea to the Democratic Party to not go ahead and nominate Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 伯尼·桑德斯无法再奔走各地，在体育场里召集数万人，并向民主党发出强有力的恳求，要求他们不要提名乔·拜登。

sentences.en: The window to make that argument has essentially closed.
sentences.zh: 提出这一论点的窗口期基本上已经关闭了。

sentences.en: What's also going on is that the terms of debate go from being about ideological differences and policy differences to the reality of a terrifying national crisis.
sentences.zh: 同时发生的情况是，辩论的焦点从意识形态差异和政策分歧，转向了可怕的国家危机的现实。

sentences.en: And what we see consistently in public polling for months and in exit polls taken around the March primaries is that on the question of which candidate you trust to handle a major crisis,
sentences.zh: 几个月来的民意调查以及3月初选期间的出口民调一致显示，在“你信任哪位候选人来处理重大危机”这个问题上，

sentences.en: Joe Biden is overwhelmingly favored, not just over Bernie Sanders, but over every alternative that Democratic voters had in the race.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登获得了压倒性的支持，不仅超过了伯尼·桑德斯，也超过了民主党选民在竞选中拥有的所有其他选择。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So in a sense, the coronavirus doesn't just freeze the campaign and freeze Joe Biden's advantages electorally.
sentences.zh: 所以从某种意义上说，新冠病毒不仅冻结了竞选，也冻结了乔·拜登在选举上的优势。

sentences.en: It amplifies them because many Democratic voters see him as a crisis style leader.
sentences.zh: 它反而放大了这些优势，因为许多民主党选民视他为危机型领导人。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, that's interesting because another way of thinking about this and the impact that we're seeing already on Americans from this pandemic, the health care shortcomings,
sentences.zh: 嗯，这很有趣，因为从另一个角度思考这场大流行对美国人已经产生的影响，以及医疗保健的短板，

sentences.en: the thin financial cushion on which so many Americans are living.
sentences.zh: 还有许多美国人赖以生存的薄弱财务缓冲。

sentences.en: That's interesting.
sentences.zh: 这很有意思。

sentences.en: That's the stuff that Bernie Sanders has been saying forever.
sentences.zh: 这些正是伯尼·桑德斯一直以来都在说的事情。

sentences.en: So I could also imagine a version of this where the pandemic strengthens Sanders candidacy, not weakens it.
sentences.zh: 所以我也可以想象出另一种版本：大流行反而加强了桑德斯的竞选势头，而不是削弱它。

sentences.en: I think that's really, really sharply put.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你总结得非常非常精辟。

sentences.en: But I do think people are processing this differently than they would process, for instance, a crash just of the financial sector,
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为，人们处理这件事的方式与处理例如单纯的金融行业崩溃的方式不同，

sentences.en: that if you saw an economic collapse in which people felt like the government was racing to contain a contagion from the financial industry and that their lives were basically safe.
sentences.zh: 如果看到的是一场经济崩溃，人们会觉得政府正在竞相遏制金融行业的传染，而他们的生活基本是安全的。

sentences.en: I suspect that we might be having a different political debate right now and that you would see Bernie Sanders holding these enormous rallies and making exactly the case you just laid out.
sentences.zh: 我怀疑我们现在可能会进行一场不同的政治辩论，你会看到伯尼·桑德斯举行这些大型集会，并提出你刚才所说的那种观点。

sentences.en: And I think that things are so turbulent and unpredictable right now that we can't totally rule out the possibility that maybe that happens at some point.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为现在局势如此动荡且不可预测，我们不能完全排除在某个时刻发生这种情况的可能性。

sentences.en: Once people see the scale of economic damage and the kind of vividness that we certainly and unfortunately will.
sentences.zh: 一旦人们看到经济损害的规模，以及我们肯定会不幸目睹的那种惨状。

sentences.en: What we have right now, though, is people are experiencing a terrifying disruption in their daily lives.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们现在所处的情况是，人们正在经历日常生活中可怕的混乱。

sentences.en: They're experiencing it, yes, as an economic crisis, but also as a public health crisis and something that probably feels to a lot of people like a national security crisis.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们将其视为一场经济危机，但同时也将其视为一场公共卫生危机，对许多人来说，这可能感觉像是一场国家安全危机。

sentences.en: And while a lot of Sanders themes and ideas about the economy will probably be a bigger part of the conversation in the coming months,
sentences.zh: 虽然桑德斯关于经济的许多主题和想法在未来几个月可能会成为对话中更重要的一部分，

sentences.en: I don't know that the country has reached that point yet.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道这个国家是否已经到了那个阶段。

sentences.en: So I want to turn now to the practical question of how the rest of the Democratic primary unfolds, because the situation we're in hasn't just frozen the dynamics of the race.
sentences.zh: 所以我想转到实际问题，即民主党初选的后续将如何展开，因为我们所处的局势不仅冻结了竞选的动态。

sentences.en: It also seems to have actually frozen the mechanics of the campaign,
sentences.zh: 它似乎还实际上冻结了竞选的机制，

sentences.en: which feels pretty tricky because people have to leave their homes and go vote in order for there to ever be a nominee.
sentences.zh: 这感觉相当棘手，因为人们必须离开家去投票，才能产生候选人。

sentences.en: So how is that going to work?
sentences.zh: 那么这该如何运作呢？

sentences.en: Well, the short answer is we still don't really know.
sentences.zh: 嗯，简短的回答是，我们仍然不太清楚。

sentences.en: Almost every day now we hear from another state that is delaying its primary well into May or even into June.
sentences.zh: 现在几乎每天我们都会听到另一个州将初选推迟到5月甚至6月。

sentences.en: Now, some of the relevance of those changes is going to depend on what Bernie Sanders does next.
sentences.zh: 现在，这些变化的相关性在一定程度上取决于伯尼·桑德斯下一步怎么做。

sentences.en: If Sanders does stick around and if Biden is not able to functionally unify the Democratic Party with or without Bernie Sanders support, then we could see this really weird,
sentences.zh: 如果桑德斯坚持下去，而拜登无法在有或没有伯尼·桑德斯支持的情况下有效地统一民主党，那么我们可能会看到这种非常奇怪的、

sentences.en: long period of dormancy in the campaign,
sentences.zh: 漫长的竞选沉寂期，

sentences.en: followed by a sudden frenzy of activity again in the late spring when maybe the virus will be more under control and maybe people will start voting again.
sentences.zh: 随后在春末可能会出现突然的活动狂潮，届时病毒可能得到更好的控制，人们可能开始再次投票。

sentences.en: Personally, right now, I think that that is an unlikely scenario.
sentences.zh: 就我个人而言，目前我认为这种情况不太可能发生。

sentences.en: Alex,
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯，

sentences.en: what's your understanding of how Bernie Sanders is thinking of the big and difficult question of how long to stay in the race if it doesn't really seem there's a practical path to the nomination?
sentences.zh: 你对伯尼·桑德斯如何思考“如果看起来没有实际的提名途径，该在竞选中停留多久”这个重大而困难的问题有什么理解？

sentences.en: He's certainly hearing lots of calls to step aside in a moment of crisis, kind of let the party coalesce around a nominee and prepare itself for a general election.
sentences.zh: 他当然听到了许多要求他在危机时刻退出的呼声，让党派团结在一位候选人周围，并为大选做准备。

sentences.en: I think there are a couple of things about the mindset of the Sanders camp right now that are really worth emphasizing here.
sentences.zh: 我认为桑德斯阵营目前的心态有几点非常值得强调。

sentences.en: One is that this is a group that, you know, not that long ago thought that they were on not a glide path, but a pretty convincing course to the nomination,
sentences.zh: 第一，这是一个不久前还认为自己并非处于平稳过渡，而是处于通往提名之路的相当令人信服的轨道上的群体，

sentences.en: and they saw it fall away with astonishing speed.
sentences.zh: 他们眼睁睁看着这一切以惊人的速度消失。

sentences.en: So there's a level, I think, still of kind of shell shock at feeling like they had this or they were close to having this, and then it was yanked away from them.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，他们仍然有一种“炮弹休克”的感觉，觉得他们本已胜券在握，或者接近成功，然后却被硬生生地夺走了。

sentences.en: That's a hard thing for a campaign, and especially for a candidate to process.
sentences.zh: 这对竞选团队，尤其是对候选人来说，是一件很难消化的事情。

sentences.en: I think the conditions of the pandemic also make it harder for, well, anybody involved in the race at this point to think through what is the right thing to do next.
sentences.zh: 我认为大流行的条件也让此时参与竞选的任何人更难思考下一步该怎么做才是正确的。

sentences.en: What we know about Bernie Sanders is that he cares a great deal about his agenda.
sentences.zh: 我们了解伯尼·桑德斯的一点是，他非常关心自己的议程。

sentences.en: And we also know that, as a personal matter, he likes Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 我们也知道，就个人而言，他喜欢乔·拜登。

sentences.en: This is not the Sanders-Clinton rivalry.
sentences.zh: 这与桑德斯和克林顿的竞争不同。

sentences.en: He doesn't feel that the party really conspired to kneecap him in this race in the way that he did with some justification in 2016.
sentences.zh: 他不觉得党派真的像2016年那样（当时他有理由这么认为）密谋在这次竞选中对他下黑手。

sentences.en: So what you see here is a candidate, Sanders, who I think understands what an underdog he is right now, and an opponent in Biden who is a negotiator.
sentences.zh: 所以你在这里看到的是一位候选人——桑德斯，我认为他明白自己现在处于多么劣势的地位，而他的对手拜登是一位谈判者。

sentences.en: And I think that's why you're seeing Biden make such explicit overtures to Sanders supporters.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是为什么你看到拜登向桑德斯的支持者做出如此明确的示好。

sentences.en: Tonight, in keeping with the latest guidance from the CDC, I'm speaking to you from my home in Wilmington, Delaware.
sentences.zh: 今晚，为了遵守疾控中心的最新指导方针，我正在特拉华州威尔明顿的家中向你们发表讲话。

sentences.en: That in the last two primary nights that we'll have for a while, he has, in his election night remarks, addressed himself to Sanders supporters.
sentences.zh: 在我们将要经历一段时间的最后两个初选之夜，他在选举之夜的讲话中，都向桑德斯的支持者发表了谈话。

sentences.en: So let me say, especially to the young voters who have been inspired by Senator Sanders, I hear you.
sentences.zh: 所以，让我对那些受到桑德斯参议员激励的年轻选民说，我听到了你们的声音。

sentences.en: I know what's at stake.
sentences.zh: 我知道利害攸关。

sentences.en: I know what we have to do.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们必须做什么。

sentences.en: Saying that he admires their enthusiasm and their ideas.
sentences.zh: 他说他钦佩他们的热情和想法。

sentences.en: Senator Sanders and his supporters have brought a remarkable passion and tenacity to all of these issues.
sentences.zh: 桑德斯参议员和他的支持者为所有这些议题带来了非凡的激情和韧性。

sentences.en: Together, they have shifted the fundamental conversation in this country.
sentences.zh: 他们共同改变了这个国家的基本对话。

sentences.en: He gave them credit for having fundamentally changed the framework of American politics.
sentences.zh: 他肯定了他们从根本上改变了美国政治框架的功劳。

sentences.en: And he, specifically addressing young people, said...
sentences.zh: 他特别对年轻人说……

sentences.en: Senator Sanders and I may disagree on tactics, but we share a common vision.
sentences.zh: 桑德斯参议员和我可能在策略上存在分歧，但我们有着共同的愿景。

sentences.en: For the need to provide affordable health care for all Americans, reduce income and equity that has risen so drastically,
sentences.zh: 为了实现为所有美国人提供负担得起的医疗保健，减少急剧上升的收入不平等，

sentences.en: to tackling the existential threat of our time, climate change.
sentences.zh: 以及应对我们这个时代存在的生存威胁——气候变化。

sentences.en: He understands the gravity of the challenges that they feel in their lives.
sentences.zh: 他理解他们生活中所感受到的挑战的严重性。

sentences.en: When Biden takes those steps, it's a clear signal that he's trying to show Bernie Sanders that he has respect for the movement that he's built.
sentences.zh: 当拜登采取这些步骤时，这是一个明确的信号，表明他试图向伯尼·桑德斯展示他尊重他所建立的运动。

sentences.en: We have to step up and care for one another.
sentences.zh: 我们必须站出来，互相关心。

sentences.en: Thank you all.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家。

sentences.en: Thank you all for listening.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家的聆听。

sentences.en: Finally, Alex, if Joe Biden is becoming a kind of de facto nominee over the next few weeks during this dormancy in the campaign,
sentences.zh: 最后，亚历克斯，如果乔·拜登在未来几周竞选沉寂期间正成为事实上的提名人，

sentences.en: and if it starts to feel like a general election is getting underway between Biden and President Trump, I wonder what this really unique set of circumstances,
sentences.zh: 如果感觉拜登和特朗普总统之间的大选正在进行，我想知道这一系列非常独特的情况，

sentences.en: which has meant so much for the Democratic primary, is going to mean for Biden's potential challenger, the sitting president, Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 这对民主党初选意义重大，对拜登的潜在挑战者——现任总统唐纳德·特朗普来说意味着什么？

sentences.en: We know that the president is not going to be able to run for re-election on a message that happy days are here again, and there's nothing but prosperity as far as we can see.
sentences.zh: 我们知道总统将无法再以“好日子又回来了，我们所见之处皆是繁荣”这样的信息来竞选连任。

sentences.en: That message is gone.
sentences.zh: 那个信息已经消失了。

sentences.en: What we don't know is what kind of story he will be able to tell about managing this crisis.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道的是，他将能够讲述什么样的关于管理这场危机的故事。

sentences.en: We just don't know what the conditions on the ground are going to be like in a couple of months, let alone in the general election.
sentences.zh: 我们只是不知道几个月后，更不用说在大选时，实地的状况会是什么样。

sentences.en: When this crisis hit, Joe Biden had a pretty solid advantage over the president in general election polls.
sentences.zh: 当这场危机来袭时，乔·拜登在大选民调中对总统拥有相当稳固的优势。

sentences.en: The map just feels to me like it's really up for grabs right now because we've never conducted an election under these kinds of conditions.
sentences.zh: 地图对我来说感觉现在完全是悬而未决的，因为我们从未在这种条件下进行过选举。

sentences.en: And even 2008, the election in the middle of a financial crisis, we hadn't had the kind of time that we are going to have now
sentences.zh: 即使是2008年那场在金融危机期间进行的选举，我们也没有像现在这样有这么多时间

sentences.en: to process the meaning of the setbacks that the country is currently experiencing.
sentences.zh: 来消化这个国家目前正在经历的挫折的含义。

sentences.en: It's interesting you mentioned 2008 because it feels to me that that race might be the proper analogy.
sentences.zh: 你提到2008年很有意思，因为我觉得那场竞选可能是最恰当的类比。

sentences.en: A crisis.
sentences.zh: 一场危机。

sentences.en: And as you said throughout this conversation,
sentences.zh: 正如你在整个谈话中所说，

sentences.en: Democrats are starting to view Joe Biden as the candidate of crisis.
sentences.zh: 民主党人开始将乔·拜登视为危机候选人。

sentences.en: I'm sure Republicans view President Trump as the candidate of crisis.
sentences.zh: 我相信共和党人将特朗普总统视为危机候选人。

sentences.en: And the question will become, once this crisis is over, what the general electorate views as the candidate of the crisis,
sentences.zh: 问题将变成，一旦这场危机结束，广大选民会将谁视为危机候选人，

sentences.en: who handled the crisis well, and who would get us out of the crisis beSt.
sentences.zh: 谁处理好了危机，谁能最好地带领我们走出危机。

sentences.en: And is there a candidate they blame for the crisis?
sentences.zh: 还有，是否有候选人被他们归咎于这场危机？

sentences.en: If people ultimately see the president as having let them down in this, that feels awfully hard to escape.
sentences.zh: 如果人们最终认为总统在这件事上让他们失望了，那感觉很难逃脱责任。

sentences.en: As it is, we can't say that that's how the country is going to feel, but we can say that he was an unpopular president on the day this crisis started.
sentences.zh: 目前，我们不能说这个国家一定会这样想，但我们可以说，在这场危机开始的那天，他就是一位不受欢迎的总统。

sentences.en: And that it's certainly not, based on what we know now, changing that picture in his favor.
sentences.zh: 而且根据我们目前所知，这肯定不会改变对他有利的局面。

sentences.en: Alex, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, global efforts to contain the coronavirus by restricting people's movements intensified.
sentences.zh: 周末，全球通过限制人员流动来遏制新冠病毒的努力加剧了。

sentences.en: Australia ordered most public spaces closed.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚下令关闭大多数公共场所。

sentences.en: India said it was shutting down all but essential services in its capital, Delhi.
sentences.zh: 印度表示将关闭其首都德里除基本服务以外的所有服务。

sentences.en: Germany limited gatherings to no more than two people.
sentences.zh: 德国将聚会人数限制在不超过两人。

sentences.en: Britain ordered 1.5 million people with serious medical probleMs.
sentences.zh: 英国下令150万有严重医疗问题的人员。

sentences.en: to self-quarantine and Lebanon called in the army to endorse a lockdown.
sentences.zh: 进行自我隔离，黎巴嫩动用军队来支持封锁。

sentences.en: We are certainly at war.
sentences.zh: 我们确实处于战争状态。

sentences.en: In a time of war, we have to make sacrifices.
sentences.zh: 在战争时期，我们必须做出牺牲。

sentences.en: And I certainly, in the last week or so, have asked the people of Ohio to make many sacrifices.
sentences.zh: 在过去一周左右的时间里，我确实要求俄亥俄州的人民做出许多牺牲。

sentences.en: In the United States, Ohio and Louisiana became the latest states to instruct residents to stay at home as infections in each state.
sentences.zh: 在美国，俄亥俄州和路易斯安那州成为最新指示居民留在家中的州，因为每个州的感染人数都在增加。

sentences.en: Other states have referred to this as shelter in place.
sentences.zh: 其他州将此称为“居家令”。

sentences.en: In Washington, negotiations over a $2 trillion stimulus package designed to protect businesses and workers hurt by the pandemic
sentences.zh: 在华盛顿，关于一项旨在保护受大流行影响的企业和工人的2万亿美元刺激计划的谈判，

sentences.en: The proposal that leader McConnell from the Republican side has put forth is absolutely, totally worried about Wall Street at this time.
sentences.zh: 共和党领袖麦康奈尔提出的提案，在这个时候绝对是完全为了华尔街着想。

sentences.en: On Sunday, Senate Democrats blocked the stimulus bill, saying it favors big business and does not contain enough protections for workers
sentences.zh: 周日，参议院民主党人阻止了这项刺激法案，称其偏袒大企业，且没有为工人提供足够的保护，

sentences.en: by allowing companies to fire workers even after receiving federal bailouts.
sentences.zh: 因为它允许公司在获得联邦救助后仍然解雇工人。

sentences.en: And Wall Street's going to do just fine, it's always rebounded real well.
sentences.zh: 华尔街会没事的，它总是反弹得很好。

sentences.en: They've always come back strong.
sentences.zh: 他们总是能强势回归。

sentences.en: Several Senate Republicans failed to cast votes because they are self-quarantining over fears that they may have been exposed to the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 几位共和党参议员未能投票，因为他们担心自己可能接触过新冠病毒而正在自我隔离。

sentences.en: And at least one senator, Republican Rand Paul of Kentucky, has now tested positive for the virus.
sentences.zh: 至少有一位参议员，肯塔基州的共和党人兰德·保罗，现在病毒检测呈阳性。

sentences.en: The Times is providing free access to our most important updates on the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 《时报》正在免费提供关于大流行的最重要更新。

sentences.en: To read it, go to nytimes.com slash coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 要阅读这些内容，请访问 nytimes.com/coronavirus。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《地铁》的最新一集中，我和莎拉·凯尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 地铁。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在您获取播客的任何平台收听。
